e: Progesterone ↑es central respiratory drive → hyperventilation in pregnancy.
↓es renal perfusion pressure → ↑es renin release from JG cells (baroreceptor-mediated).
Photoreceptors are unique among sensory receptors in hyperpolarizing (not depolarizing) on stimulation by light.
Dentate gyrus of the hippocampus is a recognised site of adult neurogenesis.
The negatively-charged glomerular basement membrane repels anions → cations filtered most readily at a given radius.
SGLT1 co-transports Na⁺ c̅ glucose, driving water absorption independent of the defective CFTR channel — the basis of oral rehydration therapy.

RCA flow is biphasic (systole + diastole) since RV pressure stays low throughout the cycle.
LCA flow is mainly diastolic, as high LV systolic pressure compresses intramural vessels.
Damaged glomerular filtration barrier → proteinuria (albumin leaks into urine).

Thick ascending limb (NKCC2) actively pumps out NaCl but is water-impermeable → counter-current multiplier.
Vasa recta = counter-current exchanger.

Insulin ↑es GLUT4 translocation in skeletal muscle (and adipose).
Liver uses GLUT2, which is insulin-independent.
Exogenous testosterone → negative feedback on hypothalamus/pituitary → LH ↓es and FSH ↓es.
Pacinian corpuscle = onion-like lamellated encapsulated ending in the deep dermis; senses vibration and deep pressure.
Intercalated disc = fascia adherens (cadherins) + desmosomes + gap junctions; tight junctions are absent.

Insulin ↑es protein synthesis and ↓es blood glucose; epinephrine ↑es glycogenolysis; glucagon ↑es gluconeogenesis.
Thyroxine ↑es (not ↓es) BMR.
